runners.comment: Suffered heavy defeat when 100-1 for last week's stable/hurdle debut at Taunton
runners.name: American Trio
runners.spotlight: 0-8 in points; suffered heavy defeat when 100-1 for last week's stable/hurdle debut at Taunton (2m, good); not the most obvious answer.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten on recent stable/hurdle debut at Hereford
runners.name: Below The Belt
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability when third of six in Lingfield (AW) bumper in December, his second start, but was soundly beaten on recent stable/hurdle debut at Hereford (2m3f, good).

runners.comment: Placed in Wincanton maiden last year and fourth in good Taunton handicap last month
runners.name: Constellation Walk
runners.spotlight: Displayed improvement when creditable third in Wincanton maiden (1m7f, soft) in December, his third start over hurdles, and subsequent fourth in good Taunton handicap (2m, heavy) was better than bare form suggests (nearly lost jockey after penultimate-flight error); doesn't help himself by racing too freely but has a good chance here.

runners.comment: Placed on Irish point debut but beaten long way on hurdle debut (2m5f); tongue-tie on
runners.name: Drumlee Orders
runners.spotlight: Joined Kerry Lee after quite promising Irish point third last April (yielding ground) but was beaten a long way on rules debut at Ludlow (2m5f, good to soft) in January; drops in trip with tongue-tie added here.

runners.comment: Third behind useful rivals on both hurdling starts and seemingly in calmer waters here
runners.name: Dutch Corner
runners.spotlight: Third against useful rivals on both hurdling starts, latterly behind recent Supreme Novices' runner-up Sober Glory at Newbury (2m, good to soft) two months ago; ideally needs to learn to settle better but he's in calmer waters here; leading contender.

runners.comment: Placed in two slow-ground bumpers this year and ought to have a future over jumps
runners.name: Elusive Pb
runners.spotlight: Out of sister to smart jumper Out Sam; placed in slow-ground bumpers at Wincanton and Fakenham this year and, although that form probably isn't anything to get too excited about, he ought to have a future over jumps.

runners.comment: Placed in all three bumpers and can probably better last month's low-key hurdle run
runners.name: Im Wide Awake
runners.spotlight: Placed in all three bumpers, perhaps most notably when second of 15 on soft ground here in December, and wasn't the only one who struggled to keep up with the useful winner when switched to hurdling at Chepstow (2m, soft; beaten 68l) last month; might get closer to the target today.

runners.comment: Ran okay on Flat debut in 2023; not seen again until pulled up over hurdles last month
runners.name: Inkaman
runners.spotlight: Not disgraced in useful Newbury maiden on Flat debut in 2023 but wasn't seen again until pulled up (albeit on heavy ground) over hurdles for new stable six weeks ago.

runners.comment: Looked promising over hurdles in France in early 2025; makes British debut here
runners.name: Karpenn
runners.spotlight: Absent since well-held third on chasing debut in France just under a year ago but displayed considerable promise over hurdles beforehand and has joined respected connections for career in Britain; had wind op in December; interesting to see how he fares.

runners.comment: Belied 125-1 odds when placed at Newbury last month; in the mix if in same form again
runners.name: My Boy Aaron
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on both hurdling starts in the autumn but, after a wind op, belied 125-1 odds when third of 11 at Newbury (2m, soft) last month; won't be far away if in similar form again here.

runners.comment: Well beaten at triple-digit odds in two bumpers and on recent hurdling debut; blinkers on
runners.name: Play On Court
runners.spotlight: Well beaten at triple-digit odds in two bumpers and on recent hurdling debut at Taunton (2m3f, good to soft); drops back in trip with blinkers added here.

runners.comment: Fair second on hurdle debut last April; absent since lesser effort in November
runners.name: Southfield Finale
runners.spotlight: From excellent jumping family and made pretty good start to hurdling career when second (no threat to short-odds winner) at Newton Abbot (2m2f, heavy) last April; returned from break with lesser effort in November, though, and has been absent for another four months since.

runners.comment: Absent since heavy defeat at triple-digit odds on bumper debut in summer 2024
runners.name: Wozitworththewait
runners.spotlight: Absent since heavy defeat at triple-digit odds on bumper debut at Worcester (good) in summer 2024.

runners.breeder: Phillip C And Mrs Kathryn M Dando
runners.comment: Pulled up when a big-priced outsider for last month's hurdling debut at Hereford
runners.name: Honey Haze
runners.spotlight: Pulled up when a big-priced outsider for last month's hurdling debut at Hereford (2m, soft).

runners.comment: Struggled when 300-1 for rules debut over C&D (good to soft) 11 days ago
runners.name: Mrs Pen
runners.spotlight: Struggled when 300-1 for rules debut over C&D (good to soft) 11 days ago.

runners.comment: Showed no significant promise in two Flat novice races last summer; hurdle debut today
runners.name: Signore Enzo
runners.spotlight: Showed no significant promise in two Flat novice races last summer (7f/1m) and can only be watched on this hurdling debut.

runners.comment: In poor form for new stable this season but still worth a check in the betting
runners.name: The Jam Man
runners.spotlight: In poor form over hurdles and fences for new stable this season and getting very long in the tooth now but has plummeted down the weights and may yet stage some sort of a revival; watch the betting.

runners.comment: 0-6 over hurdles but kept on for second over C&D on latest outing in November
runners.name: Lokis Mischief
runners.spotlight: 0-6 over hurdles but kept on for second over C&D (good; no threat to winner) on latest outing in November and has obvious each-way claims if he resumes in similar form.

runners.comment: Course winner in early 2025 but recent efforts no better than respectable
runners.name: Looking For Larry
runners.spotlight: Rewarded heavy market support when winning by 6l here (2m5f, soft) at start of 2025 but not much has gone to plan since and his two runs this year were no better than respectable; needs to up his game.

runners.comment: Irish point winner; began rules career with two encouraging runs; can improve in handicaps
runners.name: Jurassic Pet
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner who launched rules career with two encouraging hurdle runs last month (2m5f/2m3f, soft; tongue tied for both) and should have improvement to come in handicaps; one to consider.

runners.comment: Out of sorts this season and moves up in trip with quite a bit to prove
runners.name: Tarbuck
runners.spotlight: Now 3lb lower than when winning on handicap debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, soft) 13 months ago but has looked out of sorts on his three outings this season (well backed last time) and moves up in trip with quite a bit to prove.

runners.comment: Has done well over fences for new stable; back hurdling on a lower mark; major player
runners.name: Special John
runners.spotlight: Started off for Sam Thomas with two chase wins in the autumn (3m/3m2f, good to soft) and subsequently ran well in quite valuable Windsor marathon; reverts to hurdling on a lower mark and needs to be taken very seriously; wears first-time cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Won at Wincanton in January, despite still looking green, and can probably improve again
runners.name: Local Derby
runners.spotlight: Always behind on handicap debut in December but scored at Wincanton (2m4f, heavy; well backed) the following month, despite still looking green in closing stages; suffered a mishap on latest outing but could still have untapped potential over staying trips and remains of strong interest.

runners.comment: Bettered low-key handicap debut when respectable third last time; more is needed again
runners.name: Pops Folly
runners.spotlight: Bettered inauspicious handicap debut when respectable third of seven at Huntingdon (3m1f, good to soft) this month; remains lightly raced but needs further improvement today.

runners.comment: Has performed well on all three starts since course win in November; respected
runners.name: Square Du Roule
runners.spotlight: Came good here (2m5f, good to soft) in November, his 14th hurdling start, and has performed well over 3m at Taunton on all three starts since; ought to be right in the thick of things again.

runners.comment: Second in a chase in December but pulled up twice since; first hurdle run since 2023
runners.name: Shot Boii
runners.spotlight: Seemingly back in good nick when second over fences in December but two lacklustre efforts have followed and it's hard to predict whether this first hurdle run since 2023 will rekindle his enthusiasm.

runners.breeder: Phillip C And Mrs Kathryn M Dando
runners.comment: Had ground excuse when returning from a layoff and remains lightly raced; not ruled out
runners.name: Dessie Haze
runners.spotlight: Made pretty good start to handicap career when keeping-on fourth at Ffos Las (2m4f, good) last May and may not have been suited by the soft ground when making low-key reappearance in January; still unexposed as a stayer and has each-way claims if that recent outing brought him on.

runners.comment: Won here two starts ago but is not one to rely upon; others preferred
runners.name: Bredon Hill Dart
runners.owner: R W And Mrs Mitchell D V Gardner
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with 4l win here (2m5f, heavy) last month but was safely held when fourth over C&D (good to soft) 11 days ago and is not one to rely upon; others preferred.

runners.comment: Absent since modest sixth on last summer's handicap debut; now with new stable
runners.name: Klervia
runners.spotlight: 0-4 over hurdles when based with Barry Brennan and absent since modest sixth on handicap debut at Newton Abbot (2m5f, good) last summer; considered only if lively in the betting before this stable debut.

runners.comment: Ran on well for third over C&D this month but is 0-19 over hurdles now; others look safer
runners.name: Blue In The West
runners.spotlight: Gave good account over C&D (good to soft) 11 days ago, running on strongly from the rear to finish third, but he's 0-19 over hurdles now and is not straightforward; others look safer.

runners.comment: Might find others better handicapped but is in good form and probably won't be far away
runners.name: Watchoutitscookie
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in a chase in January but quickly back in good form over hurdles since, finishing second to Local Derby at Wincanton (2m4f, heavy) and third behind Bredon Hill Dart here (2m5f, heavy); quicker ground also suits; probably wont be far away.

runners.comment: Not firing on all cylinders this season and inconsistent nowadays too
runners.name: Moonlight Artist
runners.owner: The Cheltenham & South West Racing Club
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D in 2023 and was also successful over fences last spring but has not been firing on all cylinders this season and is inconsistent nowadays too.

runners.comment: Yet to add to French chase win in 2022, and recent hurdling form has been underwhelming
runners.name: I Love You Sivola
runners.spotlight: Gained only win (from 43 starts) in a French chase in 2022 and recent hurdling form does not suggest he's poised to add to his tally.

runners.comment: Struggled last year and competes from 6lb out of handicap today; had wind op in January
runners.name: Elfride
runners.spotlight: Struggled last year and competes from 6lb out of the handicap today; needs January's wind op to have made a big difference.

runners.comment: Tailed off on sole outing this term but retains potential judged on last season's promise
runners.name: Pyleigh Master
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at Chepstow in December on sole run this season and could do with settling better (2m7f, good to soft; attracted market support on that handicap debut); however, he readily made all under Ella Herbison in a maiden hurdle at Ffos Las (2m4f, soft) last April and retains potential.

runners.comment: Flat, hurdle and chase winner in Ireland but the last of those victories was in July 2024
runners.name: Son Of Hypnos
runners.spotlight: Flat, hurdle and chase winner in Ireland; however, the latest of those victories was in July 2024 and the handicapper has taken no chances with his opening British mark; he may be best watched.

runners.comment: Won first two h'caps and latest run may have come too soon; might still have more to offer
runners.name: Eton Mes
runners.spotlight: Won on handicap debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, soft) in January and followed up at Wincanton (2m5f, heavy), both under Rian Corcoran; when third at Ffos Las (2m4f, heavy) it maybe came too soon, just six days after the Wincanton win; 7lb higher mark has now kicked in but he may still have more to offer.

runners.comment: 3rd on handicap debut at Southwell; improvement needed but lightly raced and in good hands
runners.name: Firm But Fair
runners.spotlight: Consistent thus far in very short career, beaten about 11l when third of nine at 9-2 on last month's handicap debut at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft); improvement needed today but he's lightly raced and in good hands.

runners.comment: Makes h'cap debut after 2nd wind op; interesting, especially if attracting market support
runners.name: Allstitchedup
runners.spotlight: Awarded a point in February 2024 (3m, heavy); encouraging third on hurdle debut at Ffos Las (2m4f, soft) in November; took backward step there ten days later (2m4f, soft) but now goes handicapping following a second wind surgery; interesting contender, especially if attracting market support.

runners.comment: In good form over fences prior to failing to stay 3m5f last time; could go well
runners.name: Astronomic View
runners.spotlight: In good form over fences prior to heavy defeat at Bangor where he failed to stay 3m5f; could go well now back down in trip on first hurdle start since December 2024.

runners.comment: Tailed off on sole outing this season but lightly raced and with top yard; not written off
runners.name: George Henry
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at Lingfield (2m7f, soft) in December on sole outing this season; something to prove on that back of that but this very lightly raced 7yo is with a good yard and has shown promise previously; wears first-time cheekpieces and he's not written off.

runners.comment: Better could have been expected at Hereford but he won here two starts ago
runners.name: Ri Na Cuirte
runners.spotlight: Much better could have been expected at Hereford (3m1f, good to soft) in December last time but he won here (2m7f, good to soft) in November and it will be no surprise if he bounces back with a good run now back here in a first-time visor (replacing blinkers).

runners.breeder: R F And S D Knipe
runners.comment: Runner-up in first two handicaps and this unexposed 6yo could continue to progress
runners.name: Madajovy
runners.spotlight: 4l runner-up on handicap debut at Warwick (2m3f, good to soft) on New Year's Eve and similar outcome in first-time cheekpieces (retained) at Plumpton (3m1f, soft) last month; this unexposed 6yo could continue to progress for his top stable and he's a possible player.

runners.breeder: Dr V Bernard Stoffel & Mr J P Guisset
runners.comment: Prolific in points prior to last month's C&D 2nd when back under rules; in with a chance
runners.name: Noble Blue
runners.spotlight: Having been prolific in points he reverted to rules over C&D (heavy) last month and posted a 4l second of seven as the 6-5 favourite, travelling well and rallying after being outpaced in the straight; in with a chance.

runners.comment: Running well in defeat and latest second at Taunton has been franked by the winner
runners.name: Snapdance
runners.spotlight: 0-9 but he's run well in defeat in handicaps on his last three starts (3m/2m5f, good to soft); his latest second at Taunton has been franked by the winner and he could be firmly involved.

runners.comment: Consistent; won off 1lb higher, beating Bonza Boy, on last attempt at Exeter; solid
runners.name: Sherborne
runners.spotlight: Ran respectably at Taunton last time and remains a consistent sort; scored off 1lb higher, beating Bonza Boy, on most recent attempt at Exeter (13 months ago); solid chance.

runners.comment: Has a strong record in Exeter chases; the form of his most recent win has worked out well
runners.name: Bonza Boy
runners.spotlight: Has a strong record (2121) in chase contests at Exeter and the form of his most recent success, in January, has worked out well; ran creditably at Wincanton since; strong claims.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De Saint-Vincent
runners.comment: Has stamina to prove back up in trip and wellbeing to prove on return from absence
runners.name: First Angel
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly at about 2m; doing well (3-6) for current yard but has stamina to prove back up in trip and wellbeing to prove on return from 14-month layoff.

runners.breeder: Mrs Larissa Kneip & Mrs Sandrine Grevet
runners.comment: Inconsistent this term but the return to this C&D may have a positive effect
runners.name: Captain Boudet
runners.spotlight: Ended last season with a C&D success in sole chase attempt at Exeter; inconsistent this term but the return to this scenario may have a positive effect.

runners.breeder: J Breton F Breton & B Beaunez
runners.comment: Exited early last time; scored over C&D in December but that Class 5 race fell apart
runners.name: Saint Cyr De Pail
runners.spotlight: Early exit here last time made it two non-completions from five chase attempts; successful over C&D in December but that Class 5 race fell apart and only two finished.

runners.comment: Made low-key start to chasing career but drops in grade here and is with a top stable
runners.name: Dyno Dave
runners.spotlight: Unseated rider on seasonal/chase/handicap debut in December and was safely held on next two outings (both on slow ground) but he'll appreciate this ease in grade and may yet come good for his top stable.

runners.comment: Three wins for new stable in the autumn; below form last month but still respected
runners.name: Getaway King
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 8yo who started off for Fergal O'Brien with three chase wins in the autumn (2m4f-2m5f, good/good to soft); returned from short break with lesser effort last month but he's very unexposed as a stayer and further progress remains possible if he's back on song here.

runners.comment: Ran in snatches and was below form last time but made good start to chase career in autumn
runners.name: Girls Best Friend
runners.spotlight: Scored at Uttoxeter (2m4f, soft) on seasonal/chase/handicap debut in November and ran well in defeat at Market Rasen (2m3f, good to soft) soon afterwards; ran in snatches and was disappointing when fifth (just behind Dyno Dave) at Ffos Las (3m heavy) in January but still considered here.

runners.comment: 0-6 over hurdles, having been pulled up last month; up in trip for chasing debut
runners.name: Tech That
runners.spotlight: 0-6 over hurdles, having been pulled up in first-time cheekpieces (now removed) last month; could plausibly be seen to better effect now he's upped in trip and switched to fences but others have much more obvious claims.

runners.comment: Still unexposed but did not achieve much when well-held second of three this month
runners.name: The Moonlight Man
runners.spotlight: Still very lightly raced under rules but was pulled up on chase/handicap debut in January and probably did not achieve much when well-held second in three-runner contest at Ffos Las (3m, heavy) this month.

runners.comment: Safely held on last two starts but his Taunton second in early February was a good effort
runners.name: Storming Nelson
runners.spotlight: Needs to up his game after two below-par recent runs (2m/2m3f) but his second to a next-time-out winner at Taunton (2m2f, heavy) in early February was a good effort and this step up in trip is an interesting move.

runners.comment: Well handicapped on old hurdling form but well held in three chases this year
runners.name: Italian Spirit
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced for his age and very well handicapped on old hurdling form but all three chase runs this year (2m4f-2m6f) have been disappointing; swaps cheekpieces for first-time blinkers today.

runners.comment: With a top stable and remains unexposed but it takes a leap of faith to support him
runners.name: Thickthorn Tom
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all four hurdling starts last year, then was pulled up when upped to 3m for chasing debut at Uttoxeter (good to soft; first-time cheekpieces) in December; with a top stable and remains unexposed but it takes a leap of faith to support him.

runners.comment: Caused 40-1 shock at Leicester (2m4f) and followed up at Warwick (3m) soon afterwards
runners.name: Voleur De Terres
runners.spotlight: Struggled in first three chases but caused 40-1 shock at Leicester (2m4f, heavy) last month and followed up at Warwick (3m, soft) a few days later; this drier ground may not be ideal but she still commands respect.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten in her first two chases and difficult to enthuse over
runners.name: Arctic Stream
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in her first two chases, more recently when last of six in Warwick mares' race won by Voleur De Terres (3m, soft) last month, and now 0-11 under all codes; difficult to enthuse over.

runners.comment: Ran big race in defeat when cheekpieces were added at Ffos Las last month; considered
runners.name: Steal The Moves
runners.spotlight: Has mixed record over fences this season but was seemingly aided by first-time cheekpieces at Ffos Las (3m, heavy) last month, where he looked sure to win when nicely clear inside the final furlong but idled and was mugged close home; no surprise if he goes well again.

runners.comment: Nine-race maiden with form-figures of PFP since switched to chasing in December
runners.name: Alderley Charlie
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden with form-figures of PFP since switched to chasing in December; 6lb wrong today; can't be recommended.

runners.comment: 0-17 under all codes; 11lb wrong here and needs major help from the new headgear
runners.name: Sans Of Gold
runners.spotlight: Returned to racing under rules with 41l defeat at Wincanton (2m4f, good to soft) three weeks ago and is now 0-17 under all codes; 11lb wrong here; needs major help from new tongue-tie and/or blinkers.

16:40.race_name: Oddschecker Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 2 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Point winner who is a half-brother to the high-class Thunder Rock; bumper debut; contender
runners.name: Eastern Rock
runners.spotlight: Easily won Irish maiden point (3m, yielding) in October on second start; changed hands for £70,000 the following month; this half-brother to the high-class Thunder Rock brings potential to his bumper debut; contender.

runners.comment: Runner-up on debut at Wincanton in January and open to improvement; firmly in calculations
runners.name: Fine Tuning
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to five winners, notably Regent's Stroll, who was sent off favourite when runner-up on debut at Wincanton (1m7f, heavy) in January, albeit no match for the winner; open to improvement; firmly in calculations.

runners.comment: Second at Wetherby in December behind one who followed up in Listed race; leading claims
runners.name: Ink Black Heart
runners.spotlight: Fourth on debut at Wincanton (good to soft) last January and second of 15 at Wetherby (2m, soft) in December on first run for Dan Skelton, behind A Likeable Rogue who followed up in a Listed race; leading claims.

runners.comment: Showed ability on debut but tailed off at Wincanton just 12 days ago
runners.name: Keep Off The Sugar
runners.spotlight: Close fifth of eight at Wincanton (1m7f, good) last March on sole run for Eve Johnson Houghton but tailed off at 125-1 there (good to soft) just 12 days ago on debut for this yard; a hood goes on; hard to fancy.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten on debut but this brother to Dashel Drasher could leave that behind
runners.name: Lingering Glance
runners.spotlight: Backed into 6-1 when 21l eighth of ten on debut at Wincanton (1m7f, heavy) two months ago; a sizeable step forward is needed but he's a brother to the stable's Grade 1 winner Dashel Drasher and it will be interesting to see if there's again some market support; not written off.

runners.comment: Attractive pedigree; from a respected stable and could give a good account on debut
runners.name: Mighty Zeus
runners.spotlight: 10,000euros yearling; 12th foal; brother to useful 2m3f-3m1f hurdle/chase winner Stellar Magic, half-brother to four winners notably Heron Heights (smart 2m3f-3m chase) and Witness In Court (useful 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase); from a respected stable and could give a good account on debut.

runners.comment: 130,000euros 3yo; trainer 6-20 (30%) in bumpers here in last five seasons; player on debut
runners.name: River Kwai
runners.spotlight: 62,000euros yearling, 130,000euros 3yo; fourth foal; brother to 3m1f chase winner Prince Des Fichaux (RPR 122), half-brother to Italian 1m7f hurdle winner; dam French 2m1f-2m6f hurdle/chase winner (including Grade 2); trainer 6-20 (30%) in bumpers here in the last five seasons; player on debut.

runners.comment: Well beaten in seventh on her first two starts and a transformation is necessary today
runners.name: Illhaveabitofthat
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in seventh on her first two starts (2m1f/2m, good to soft) and a transformation is necessary today.

runners.comment: Third foal; dam maiden pointer; wears a hood on debut; probably best watched
runners.name: Porth Mear
runners.spotlight: Third foal; dam maiden pointer, half-sister to a point winner, out of a point winner; wears a hood on debut; probably best watched.

runners.comment: 200-1 when well beaten on last month's debut at Wincanton
runners.name: New Virginia
runners.spotlight: 200-1 when well beaten on last month's debut at Wincanton.

17:13.race_name: Totnes And Bridgetown Races Company Ltd Open Hunters' Chase

runners.comment: Rolled back the years with 50-1 success at Leicester last month; enters calculations
runners.name: Enqarde
runners.spotlight: Useful in his prime; 0-6 in points this season but drew 14l clear to cause 50-1 shock in four-runner Leicester hunter chase (2m6f, soft) three weeks ago; it's tricky to gauge what that form is worth or whether his revival will gather momentum but, nevertheless, he enters calculations.

runners.comment: Won off reduced handicap mark two starts ago but has become hard to predict
runners.name: Theformismighty
runners.spotlight: Held on well to exploit reduced mark in Newcastle handicap (2m7f, heavy) in January but was quickly back in the doldrums when pulled up (albeit in valuable race) at Doncaster last month; this hunter chase debut is much less competitive but it's hard to predict whether he'll warm to the task.

runners.comment: C&D winner; shade disappointing in latest point but earlier point form gives him a shout
runners.name: Yippee Ki Yay
runners.owner: Mr And Mrs Ben Herbert And Family
runners.spotlight: Won twice under rules (once over C&D) in 2024; slightly disappointing when favourite for his latest point but the form of his first two runs this season reads quite well in this context; no surprise if he features.

runners.comment: 4-14 in points; won Cheltenham hunter chase on only rules start; good ground suits best
runners.name: Crawter
runners.spotlight: 4-14 in points; finished well to snatch victory at Cheltenham (3m2f, good) last May, his only start under rules, and comes here after very respectable second in Larkhill open point (3m, good) this month; today's ground might be slower than he prefers but he can still go well.

runners.comment: Teenager who has been out of form this season; revival needed
runners.name: DJango
runners.spotlight: Teenager who has gone over two years since his latest win and has been out of form this season (three runs); revival needed.

runners.breeder: Joel Denis & Scea Haras De Saint Voir
runners.comment: Good second at Wincanton last month but far too inconsistent to rely upon
runners.name: Gateau De Miel
runners.spotlight: Won Class 4 Stratford handicap (2m6f, good) last June and returned from layoff with creditable second in Wincanton hunter chase (2m4f, good to soft) three weeks ago; that form puts him on the premises here and he stays 3m perfectly well but he's far too inconsistent to rely upon.

runners.comment: No threat to easy winner when second at Taunton last month but that was still a good run
runners.name: Havent Time
runners.spotlight: No threat to easy winner when second at Taunton (2m7f, heavy) last month but that was still a pretty good effort and he'll probably be better suited by the less testing ground here; a possible.

runners.breeder: J Aumond E A R L Carel & F Champion
runners.comment: Clear winner of good-quality open point last month and looks the one to beat here
runners.name: Macklin
runners.spotlight: Multiple point winner who was very respectable third of five at Cheltenham (3m2f, good) last spring and was clear winner of good-quality open point at Badbury Rings (3m, good) when back in action last month; looks the one to beat here.

runners.comment: Signed off for Paul Nicholls with fairly good Wincanton third last month; stable debut
runners.name: Mr Glass
runners.spotlight: Put poor reappearance run behind him when signing off for Paul Nicholls with fair third in Wincanton hunter chase (2m4f, good to soft; behind Gateau De Miel) last month; will be fine over this longer trip and has each-way claims if in similar form for new yard; cheekpieces removed after one use.

runners.comment: Remote when third on heavy going last month but this ground should suit better
runners.name: Revels Hill
runners.spotlight: Useful handicap chaser in his prime but very lightly raced in recent years; remote when third of seven at Taunton (2m7f, heavy; behind Haven't Time) last month and current ability remains tricky to gauge but he ought to be better suited by the less testing ground here and might be boosted by the refitted cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Last year's form was uninspiring; well beaten when returning in a point this month
runners.name: Windance
runners.spotlight: Dual handicap winner in 2023 but last year's point/hunter chase form was uninspiring and he was a long way behind Crawter when reappearing in a Larkhill point this month.

runners.comment: Won three minor points last spring but failed to complete both races last month
runners.name: For Rita
runners.spotlight: Front-runner; won three minor points last spring (good to firm/good) but failed to complete both her races last month and faces a fairly tough task on this rare start under rules.

14:02.race_name: Entertain In Style At Wetherby Racecourse Mares' 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Pulled up latest but runner-up 3 times in a row previously; major player if back on song
runners.name: Biglesisback
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in handicap at Ayr (3m, soft) last month but prior to that she'd finished second three times in a row (2m-3m, good to soft/soft), including on handicap debut at Musselburgh; major player if back on song.

runners.comment: Point winner and half-sister to the useful Abuffalosoldier; could go well on rules debut
runners.name: Girl Friday
runners.owner: Old Gold Racing With Francesca Cumani II
runners.spotlight: Won a four-runner Irish mares' maiden point (3m, good) on debut in October and sold for £45,000 in November; she's a half-sister to the useful Abuffalosoldier, among others, and she could go well on her first rules start.

runners.comment: The step up in trip could suit but considerable improvement need; looks yard second-string
runners.name: I Heard A Rumour
runners.spotlight: Sister to top stable's useful 2m-2m4f winner Listentoyourheart and the step up in trip could suit, but it needs to prompt considerable improvement and Sallyville Lady looks to be the yard's chief hope.

runners.comment: Bumper winner who brings potential to her hurdle debut and could have a big part to play
runners.name: Joans Choice
runners.spotlight: Went close in bumper here (2m, soft) in November on second start then won one at Plumpton (2m2f, good to soft) in December; could do with settling better but this half-sister to connections' useful jumper Neachells Bridge brings potential to her hurdle debut and could have a big part to play.

runners.comment: Took a step forward when fifth at Newcastle but others have a lot more substance to claims
runners.name: Khaleesi Queen
runners.spotlight: Took a step forward when 22l fifth of 12 at 300-1 at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) recently on her second hurdle start but others have a lot more substance to their claims.

runners.comment: Two wins in the pointing sphere but has shown little across her three rules starts
runners.name: Royal Maggs
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing S Knowles & Partners
runners.spotlight: Two wins in the pointing sphere but hasn't shown enough across her three rules starts to suggest she'll be making an impact today.

runners.comment: Point winner; in the first three on all three hurdle starts and holds leading claims
runners.name: Sallyville Lady
runners.spotlight: Point winner (3m, good to yielding) who has finished in the first three on all three hurdle starts (2m5f/2m6f, soft/heavy), most recently on handicap debut at Ludlow when beaten just over 10l (bled from the nose); leading claims for top trainer who has a very healthy strike-rate at Wetherby.

runners.comment: 10yo who has never won off a mark but this high but he did it nicely over C&D last time
runners.name: Geryville
runners.spotlight: His last two wins have come over C&D (soft), the latest in January when last seen; also effective on good ground; this 10yo is inconsistent and has never won off a mark this high, but he comfortably made all last time and could well make another bold bid if he's on another going day.

runners.comment: Course winner who scored at Fakenham on his stable debut and is entitled to respect
runners.name: No But I Will
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Donald Smith
runners.spotlight: Won at Cartmel (2m1f, good) last August on penultimate run for Robbie Llewellyn and he scored on his stable debut at Fakenham (2m5f, soft) in December; he didn't look straightforward on that latest outing but this course winner is entitled to respect nevertheless.

runners.comment: Respectable third over 2m at Ayr last time and could benefit from the step back up in trip
runners.name: Arthurs Quay
runners.spotlight: 12yo whose form has been up and down since he won at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) last February but he's dropped down the weights and performed respectably at Ayr (2m, heavy) in December when last seen; he could benefit from today's step back up in trip and he's in with a chance.

runners.comment: Clear with a progressive winner when second at Southwell and he's high on the list
runners.name: William Cody
runners.spotlight: He's run well to be second on two of his last three starts (2m3f/2m4f, good/soft), most recently at Southwell four weeks ago; he's 4lb higher than last time but was clear with a progressive winner; high on the list.

runners.comment: 5lb below last winning mark but patchy form this season and the trip may stretch him
runners.name: Rath Gaul Hill
runners.spotlight: He's now 5lb lower than when winning at Newbury (2m, soft) last February; however, this season's form has been patchy and today's trip may stretch him; major turnaround needed with blinkers replacing cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Well handicapped on form as recent as last April but he's struggled so far for this yard
runners.name: Clonakilty
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on form for Olly Murphy as recent as last April but tailed off/pulled up over hurdles/fences on his two runs for this yard.

runners.comment: Disappointing over C&D last time but in good form previously and could bounce back
runners.name: Empty Nest
runners.owner: M Blades S Morrell K Hathaway
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who was runner-up at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) in January and filled same position at Doncaster (2m4f, soft) last month; disappointing over C&D last time but no surprise if he bounces back with a bold show.

15:12.race_name: Best Ticket Prices Online At wetherbyracing.co.uk Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Pulled up here on handicap debut but the shorter trip & forecast better ground could help
runners.name: Sweeper System
runners.spotlight: Encouraging third in maiden hurdle at Southwell (2m, good to soft) in December; pulled up on handicap debut here (2m3f, soft) since; might be back on better ground today which, along with the drop back in trip, could make him a different proposition; no surprise to see a good run.

runners.comment: Continues to drop down the weights but he's struggled this winter
runners.name: Justus
runners.spotlight: Four-time Flat winner who landed a novice hurdle in January 2024; he continues to drop down the weights but has struggled this winter and a major turnaround is necessary.

runners.comment: Has ability and makes handicap hurdle debut off modest mark; could have a part to play
runners.name: Roland Garros
runners.spotlight: Fair maiden on the Flat and he ran okay when 15l second in a maiden hurdle at Southwell (2m, soft) a fortnight ago; now goes handicapping in this code off a modest mark and he could have a part to play.

runners.comment: Ran well for a long way at Chepstow last month following a long absence; interesting
runners.name: Golden Millie
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who returned from a very long absence to make her handicap and stable debut at Chepstow (2m3f, soft) last month and ran well for a long way before fading into seventh of 12; could take a step forward now back down in trip and she's one to be interested in.

runners.comment: Yet to threaten but lightly raced and in good hands; not discounted
runners.name: Mystical Martika
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten at Kelso (2m5f, good to soft) in November in her sole handicap and same story in Hexham novice (2m, heavy) in December; this lightly raced 5yo is in good hands and today's trip, on better ground than last time, could prove to be a good fit; not discounted.

runners.comment: Disappointing on last two starts but he's well worth a second look for his in-form yard
runners.name: Cawthorne Banker
runners.spotlight: Disappointing on last two starts but he won twice in the second half of last year (2m, good to soft/good) and the fact his stable is enjoying a very productive month suggests he is well worth a second look.

runners.comment: Runner-up twice in a row at Perth in September but has struggled on his three starts since
runners.name: Kopa Kilana
runners.spotlight: Runner-up twice in a row at Perth (2m4f, good) in September but struggled on final two starts for Olly Murphy and it was the same story on his stable debut in November; returns from a break with something to prove.

runners.comment: Comfortably got off the mark over hurdles over C&D last month; 8lb rise may not stop him
runners.name: Berry Edge
runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner (including on good to soft) who got off the mark over hurdles at the seventh attempt over C&D (soft) last month; he did it comfortably and an 8lb rise may not stop him if he can back up that effort.

runners.comment: Has potential off lowly opening jumps mark judged on Flat ability; wind op since last time
runners.name: Ashdown Forest
runners.spotlight: 4yo who needs to improve on what he showed on his three hurdle starts this winter but he's had wind surgery since and has potential off his lowly opening jumps mark judged on his Flat ability; could be a contender.

runners.comment: Yet to show much but h'cap debut provides him with a more realistic chance; watch market
runners.name: Big Love
runners.spotlight: His claims aren't compelling on what he's achieved on his three hurdle starts but he's not been devoid of ability and today's handicap debut at least provides him with a more realistic chance; watch the betting.

runners.comment: Down the field in three juvenile h'dles but should be able to make an impact off this mark
runners.name: Ice Jet
runners.spotlight: Down the field in three juvenile hurdles in the autumn; however, this Dan Skelton-trained 4yo has had a wind op since and his Flat form suggests he should be capable of making an impact off this lowly opening hurdle mark.

15:47.race_name: Watch Racing TV In Stunning HD Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: Joel Denis Clotilde De Barmon Emmanuel
runners.comment: Made it 2-5 over fences at Exeter last month and this progressive 6yo holds strong claims
runners.name: Kalhandrion
runners.spotlight: He's improved for going chasing this season and made it 2-5 over fences when winning at Exeter (3m, heavy) last month in first-time cheekpieces; his other win came on good to soft; a tongue-tie joins the cheekpieces; this progressive 6yo holds strong claims.

runners.comment: His chase debut 5th gives him something to build on and perhaps the cheekpieces will help
runners.name: Eaton Anne
runners.spotlight: Beaten 13l when fifth of 11 on last month's chase debut at Chepstow (2m7f, soft); however, that performance gives this two-time hurdle winner something to build on and perhaps the first-time cheekpieces will help.

runners.comment: Tailed off on chase debut but may have needed the run; not ruled out for in-form yard
runners.name: Jack To Bat
runners.owner: Martyn & Elaine Booth & The Maiden Over
runners.spotlight: Point runner-up who also showed ability over hurdles; tailed off at 17-2 on last month's chase/handicap debut at Chepstow but that was his first run since last April and he may have needed it; wears first-time cheekpieces and the step up in trip could be a firm plus; interesting for in-form yard.

runners.comment: Easily made all at Ffos Las recently; this is stronger but he could have more to offer
runners.name: The Grey Man
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent but easily got off the mark over fences at the third attempt in three-runner handicap at Ffos Las (3m, heavy) recently; this is a stronger race but he could have more to offer in this sphere; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Pulled up in January but in pretty good heart previously; now 1lb below last winning mark
runners.name: Imperial Merlin
runners.spotlight: Pulled up at Warwick in January last time but was in pretty good heart towards the end of last year and he's now 1lb lower than when winning at Haydock (3m, good) last March; also handles soft; capable of going well.

runners.comment: Won his final two starts last season but disappointing on his three outings this term
runners.name: Kapal Layar
runners.spotlight: Won his final two starts last season (2m3f/2m4f, soft/good to soft) and there's every chance this 7yo will get back on track at some stage; however, he's been disappointing on his three outings this term and it's hard to be confident regarding his claims today.

runners.comment: Didn't run badly on his two starts last month and possible the step up in trip will suit
runners.name: Into The Park
runners.spotlight: Didn't threaten on his two runs last month (2m/2m3f, heavy/good to soft) but those weren't bad performances and it's possible this half-brother to a 3m-3m2f winner will be suited by the step up in trip; on a reduced mark and he's not discounted in first-time blinkers (replacing cheekpieces).

runners.comment: Made bad early mistake when tailed off at Ascot & this lightly raced 7yo retains potential
runners.name: Heart Over Head
runners.spotlight: Won at Uttoxeter (2m6f, heavy) in December on second handicap start and followed up at Market Rasen (2m7f, good to soft); tailed off at Ascot (2m7f, good to soft) since but made a bad early mistake; retains potential.

runners.breeder: Haras De Nonant Le Pin & M-F Corbiere
runners.comment: Unexposed 6yo who won at Ffos Las last month and could continue to progress; respected
runners.name: Libre De Choeur
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Warwick (2m5f, good to soft) in December on second handicap start and bounced back from lesser run to win at Ffos Las (3m, heavy) last month; this unexposed 6yo could continue to progress; respected.

runners.comment: Won Catterick maiden and this unexposed 7yo could prove to be superior to his opening mark
runners.name: Hawthorn Street
runners.owner: Toby Cole & Stars Of The Box
runners.spotlight: Point winner who won a maiden hurdle at Catterick (3m1f, soft) last month on his third rules start; that form reads well and this unexposed 7yo could prove to be superior to his opening mark; yard in good form.

runners.comment: Won maiden h'dle last August; improvement necessary off this mark on stable/handicap debut
runners.name: Dramatic License
runners.spotlight: Bumper runner-up who won maiden hurdle at Downpatrick (2m6f, good) last August; has shown promise on yielding to soft; tough task in Listed novice in October when fifth of six on final run for Stuart Crawford; subsequently sold for £26,000; improvement necessary on stable/handicap debut.

runners.comment: Encouraging stable debut over fences at Hereford; lower mark to work with over hurdles
runners.name: Tiger Orchid
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner for the Newland/Insole yard; returned from break with encouraging second over fences at Hereford on last month's stable debut; could build on that today and he has a lower mark to work with over hurdles.

runners.comment: Disappointing at Ayr last time but had done well previously after moving into handicaps
runners.name: Buzz Iceclear
runners.owner: Racing To Profit Syndicate & G Walford
runners.spotlight: Won in November on first two handicap starts (soft; including C&D) and solid third at Ascot (2m7f, good to soft) next time; disappointing at Ayr (3m, soft) last time but in the mix if rediscovering his previous promise.

runners.comment: Very rare run over hurdles but he's well handicapped on this season's chase form
runners.name: Ladronne
runners.spotlight: 12yo who has been better than ever over fences this season following a stable switch, with wins at Sedgefield (2m5f, soft) and Catterick (3m1f, good to soft); this is a rare run over hurdles but he has a lower mark in this sphere, in which he scored twice in 2020; likes it here; one to consider.

runners.comment: Third at Catterick in January but tougher opposition today and needs another step forward
runners.name: Rioja Alta
runners.spotlight: Won at Cartmel (2m6f, soft) last July and he's worked his way back to form, finishing third of eight at Catterick (3m1f, soft) in January; faces tougher opposition today, however, and needs another step forward.

16:55.race_name: Jumps Finale - Friday 27th March National Hunt Flat Race (Conditional/Amateurs') (Cat 1 Elim') (GBB)

runners.comment: Point winner who made it 2-2 on bumper debut; it might take a good one to beat him
runners.name: Minella Premier
runners.spotlight: Point winner (3m, good) who returned from long absence to win four-runner bumper at Fontwell on last month's rules debut (2m1f, heavy; 7-2), coming well clear with the odds-on favourite who won a point previously; carries a 7lb penalty today but it might take a good one to beat him.

runners.comment: 6,500euros foal; closely related to useful Broomfields Jenny; may be best watched on debut
runners.name: Cricket Hill Denis
runners.spotlight: 6,500euros foal; sixth foal; closely related to 2m-2m4f hurdle winner Broomfields Jeremy (RPR 134); dam bumper/2m4f hurdle winner (118); he may be best watched on debut.

runners.comment: £6,000 3yo; other newcomers make greater appeal on paper
runners.name: Johns Legacy
runners.spotlight: £6,000 3yo; second foal; dam unraced half-sister to useful 2m3f-3m chase winner Dog Of War, out of unraced half-sister to high-class winners Zaidpour and Zaynar; other newcomers make greater appeal on paper.

runners.comment: One of two newcomers for trainer with excellent record in race; he could be the chief hope
runners.name: LUnique Allen
runners.spotlight: 100,000euros 3yo; fourth foal; half-brother to smart 2m4f-2m6f hurdle/chase winner Hermes Allen; dam French 2m1f-2m3f hurdle/chase winner (including Grade 3); one of two newcomers for trainer with excellent record in this race and this fellow could be the chief hope under Lewis Saunders.

runners.comment: Half-brother to two winners; may be stable second-string but could still go well on debut
runners.name: Mr Maximillian
runners.spotlight: 40,000euros 3yo; ninth foal; half-brother to winners Bois De Clamart (bumper/useful 2m2f-2m5f hurdle/chase) and Megalypos (French 2m hurdle); dam French 2m1f-2m5f hurdle/chase winner; stablemate and fellow newcomer L'Unique Allen may be the stable first-string, but no surprise to see a big run.

runners.comment: Won at Hexham on debut then third at Newcastle; can give another good account
runners.name: Peace Belle
runners.spotlight: Mare who won on debut at Hexham (2m, good) last August and finished third at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) a fortnight ago; her limitations may again be exposed now taking on males but she can give another good account.

runners.comment: He's made the frame on his first two starts and he's an each-way player
runners.name: Static Charm
runners.spotlight: 33-1 third of 12 on debut at Catterick (1m7f, good) in November and finished much closer to the target when 50-1 fourth of 15 over this C&D (soft) in December; each-way player.

runners.comment: 16,000euros 3yo who has a useful pedigree but may be one for further down the line
runners.name: Zains Hope
runners.spotlight: 20,000euros foal, 16,000euros 3yo; eighth foal; half-brother to four winners including Hold The Note (smart bumper and 2m3f-3m hurdle/chase), the other three being useful; however, he may be one for further down the line.

runners.comment: Dam useful Flat winner; interesting to see how he goes in the betting on debut
runners.name: Rip It Up
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; dam useful 7.7f-12.4f winner, half-sister to useful 7f-1m2f Flat and 2m1f hurdle winner Lord Of The Rock, out of 7f-10.5f winner; trainer has unearthed a useful bumper performer this season and that one has a predominantly Flat pedigree; interesting to see how he goes in the betting.

runners.comment: Close second of five at Market Rasen on second start but she's in a hotter race today
runners.name: Superior Queen
runners.spotlight: Kept on well for close second of five at 22-1 at Market Rasen (2m, soft) last month on her second start; she's in a hotter race today, however, and probably needs further improvement if she's to run into a place.

16:28.race_name: Daily Profit Boosts At betmgm.co.uk Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Gained his Ayr success in the manner of a useful prospect; entered in two Irish Classics
runners.name: Nobody Knows
runners.spotlight: 320,000euros breeze-up purchase who justified strong market support at Ayr (7f) in sole 2yo start, scoring in the style of a useful prospect; entered in two Irish Classics; looks well up to defying a 7lb penalty.

runners.comment: 105,000gns yearling; by New Bay; major yard; one of the better types among the newcomers
runners.name: Mick The Hat
runners.spotlight: 105,000gns yearling; by New Bay out of unraced half-sister to 1m Group 3 winner Alexios Komnenos; represents major stable and looks one of the better types among the debutants.

runners.comment: 1,000gns yearling; by Mohaather; the least appealing contender among the debutants
runners.name: Mr Maxim
runners.spotlight: 1,000gns yearling; by Mohaather out of sprint maiden (RPR 55) who is half-sister to two winning sprinters; the least appealing contender among the newcomers.

runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival at Kempton in sole outing for Alice Haynes
runners.name: My Mate Mackley
runners.spotlight: Brings the worst form, having failed to beat a rival at Kempton (1m) in sole outing for Alice Haynes; best watched unless the betting suggests a big step forward is likely.

runners.comment: Sibling to three winners, including two for his connections; interesting newcomer
runners.name: Regulus Black
runners.spotlight: Palace Pier colt; sibling to three winners, including two for his connections, notably Native King (7.5f; RPR 94); dam Group-placed 6f 2yo scorer (99); interesting debutant.

runners.comment: Nicely bred; duly showed clear promise in Newcastle maiden; one of the main contenders
runners.name: Sintra
runners.spotlight: Nicely bred, being a Kingman half-brother to a Listed winner for his connections and a grandson of Goldikova; duly showed clear promise with running-on third in Newcastle maiden (1m); one of the main contenders.

runners.comment: 75,000gns yearling; by Mehmas; stable had a winning 3yo newcomer ten days ago
runners.name: The Anthony Gover
runners.spotlight: 75,000gns yearling; by Mehmas out of French/German 1m2f-1m3f scorer (including Group 2; RPR 109); yard had a winning 3yo newcomer (6-5 favourite) ten days ago; heed the market signals.

17:00.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Strong at the finish in the second of his two 6f races; likely to stay 7f; leading player
runners.name: Caballo Grande
runners.spotlight: Both starts over 6f in October, winning well and strong at the finish in Southwell maiden latest; this colt is likely to stay 7f and holds leading claims despite conceding plenty of weight to the fillies.

runners.comment: Gleneagles half-sister to two winners; sole newcomer in the field; market informative
runners.name: Florizelle
runners.spotlight: Gleneagles half-sister to two winners, notably War Chant (7f-1m2f including AW; RPR 86); dam sprint maiden (54); sole newcomer in the field; market instructive.

runners.comment: Close fourth at Southwell for new yard, having attracted support; may improve again
runners.name: Glasgow Kiss
runners.spotlight: Never figured in sole start for Alice Haynes but fared a lot better, having attracted support, at Southwell (7f) where she finished a close fourth; may well take another step forward; possibilities.

runners.comment: Kingman filly; showed promise at Newbury in sole 2yo start; entered in Irish 1,000 Guineas
runners.name: Lahan Kingman
runners.spotlight: Kingman filly who showed promise with third of ten in newcomers' event at Newbury (7f) in sole 2yo start; one of her stable's three entries in the Irish 1,000 Guineas; respected with progress on the cards.

runners.comment: Put in good late work on her way to close fourth of six in C&D maiden; open to improvement
runners.name: Leonie
runners.spotlight: Put in good late work on her way to close fourth of six in C&D maiden for an encouraging debut; may be dependent on the cards dropping right if she's again held up in rear; otherwise looks open to improvement.

17:30.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Handicap (Div I)

runners.comment: Nearly made all in first-time cheekpieces over C&D most recently; good chance
runners.name: Al Hofzan
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who is proving largely consistent; nearly made all in first-time cheekpieces over C&D most recently and that form has a solid look to it; good chance in the retained headgear with Harry Vigors taking off a useful 7lb.

runners.comment: Remains well treated on best turf form and takes a drop in class
runners.name: Terries Royale
runners.spotlight: Lacks solidity based on his AW record and failed to beat a rival at Wolverhampton (on debut for new yard) most recently; however, remains well treated on best turf form and takes a drop in class.

runners.comment: Suited by Wolverhampton; ran respectably last time; possibilities back down in grade
runners.name: White Umbrella
runners.spotlight: Has plenty of Wolverhampton form, notably four wins in Class 6; kept on for respectable third in Class 5 contest here (6f) with reappearance under her belt; possibilities back up in trip and back down in grade.

runners.comment: Clearcut winner in January but nowhere near that form otherwise this year
runners.name: Cill Mocheallog
runners.spotlight: Only 1-16 on AW, the success admittedly gained in clearcut style at Southwell in January; a possible danger on that form but has been nowhere near it otherwise this year; not a solid option.

runners.comment: Revival possible on debut for a trainer who won on him during riding career
runners.name: Caragio
runners.spotlight: Out of sorts last year for Martin Dunne but was previously a dual winner for Roger Teal, including under Adam Kirby who has recently commenced his training career and now houses this gelding; interesting off reduced mark dropped in class, with a revival possible.

runners.comment: The question is whether his Ffos Las form can be transferred to AW on reappearance
runners.name: Sofian
runners.spotlight: Ended his 2025 campaign in good form over the extended 7f at Ffos Las, recording an account-opening win prior to a respectable effort; the question is whether he can transfer the ability to AW on reappearance.

runners.comment: Still a maiden but has shown signs that he's capable of winning a race of this nature
runners.name: Yehudi
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden but went down by only a neck at Wolverhampton (8.5f) in December and Kempton (7f) latest start, showing clear signs that he's capable of winning a race of this nature; those are two of his six placed efforts in total; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Has doubts over current form and the trip but market support should be noted; new yard
runners.name: Orbital Chime
runners.spotlight: Record is only 2-30, the wins over 6f in 2022 (for James Horton) and 2025 for Katie Scott; sold for 5,000gns since last run; has a doubts over current form and the return to 7f but market support should be heeded; debut for James Owen.

runners.comment: Ties in with Al Hofzan on the solid piece of form that took his C&D form figures to 123
runners.name: Good Karma
runners.spotlight: Only 1-25 in handicaps, the win on turf last summer; however, ties in with Al Hofzan on the solid piece of form that took his C&D form figures to 123; enters calculations off same mark kept to this scenario.

runners.comment: Form over C&D includes a win last October and an encouraging effort on Friday; in the mix
runners.name: Simply Blue
runners.spotlight: Record of 0-12 for current yard but his form over this C&D includes sole success, which was gained off 9lb higher last October, and an encouraging effort (finished second) on Friday; fighting chance provided he belies recent inconsistency.

runners.comment: On a long losing spell and current mark reflects a decline in his form
runners.name: Swiss Ace
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful on his day but is on a long losing sequence and current mark reflects a general decline in his form; a regular at Newcastle and rarely seen at Wolverhampton.
